Select an organization before changing stock transfers.

You do not have access to this stock transfer.

service-call.name: create#zenith.erp.inventory.StockTransfer
service-call.in-map: [organizationPartyId:guard.organizationPartyId, fromFacilityId:fromFacilityId, toFacilityId:toFacilityId, transferDate:transferDate ?: ec.user.nowTimestamp, remarks:remarks, statusId:'StxDraft', totalValue:0, ewayBillRequired:'N']

return.message: Logistics can only be edited before receiving.
Received quantity must be between zero and the quantity sent.

if.condition: asset == null || asset.ownerPartyId != guard.organizationPartyId || asset.assetTypeEnumId != 'AstTpInventory' || !(direction in ['out','in']) || asset.facilityId != (direction == 'out' ? guard.transfer.fromFacilityId : guard.transfer.toFacilityId) || (direction == 'out' ? quantityDiff >= 0 : quantityDiff <= 0)

return.message: Not enough unreserved stock at the sender.

actions.script: def details = ec.entity.find('mantle.product.asset.AssetDetail').condition('assetId', assetId).list() def q = details.sum { it.quantityOnHandDiff ?: 0G } ?: 0G def a = details.sum { it.availableToPromiseDiff ?: 0G } ?: 0G def qGap = (asset.quantityOnHandTotal ?: 0G) - q def aGap = (asset.availableToPromiseTotal ?: 0G) - a if (qGap != 0G || aGap != 0G) ec.entity.makeValue('mantle.product.asset.AssetDetail').setAll([ assetId:assetId, productId:asset.productId, effectiveDate:ec.user.nowTimestamp, quantityOnHandDiff:qGap, availableToPromiseDiff:aGap, description:'Opening balance before stock transfer ' + stockTransferId]).setSequencedIdPrimary().create() ec.entity.makeValue('mantle.product.asset.AssetDetail').setAll([ assetId:assetId, productId:asset.productId, effectiveDate:ec.user.nowTimestamp, quantityOnHandDiff:quantityDiff, availableToPromiseDiff:quantityDiff, description:'Transfer ' + direction + ' ' + stockTransferId]).setSequencedIdPrimary().create()
